text:
Elaine (CS): Heads up — after today's outage we need a quick follow-up on: (1) customer-facing summary (status page), (2) timeline for fixes and owners, (3) RCA sharing policy for customers asking for more detail. Can owners volunteer?

Mike (SRE): I can own remediation for the autoscaling misconfig. ETA for fix: 3 business days for immediate config roll, 2 weeks for full mitigation (rate-limiter + more test coverage). I'll link tasks.

Shreya (PM): Noted recurring pattern: similar spike last quarter. We should add a "recurring incident" tag and schedule a retro with infra and product by EOD Fri. Owner for follow-up: Shreya. Proposed deliverables: root-cause doc, regression test, runbook updates.

Mike (SRE): Created tracker INC-4321 and assigned to me + infra. Short action list:
- Mike: hotfix config roll — due 2025-11-12
- Shreya: retro + plan — due 2025-11-15
- Elaine: customer comms draft — due 2025-11-11
- Tim: statuspage copy check — due 2025-11-11

incident-bot: Created ticket INC-4321 in Tracker. Link: https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-4321

Elaine (CS): Draft for status page — please review:
```
We experienced elevated request queuing causing increased latency for model inference between 09:12–09:45 UTC. Impact: some hosted API requests timed out; Dedicated customers on pool-x saw degraded throughput. We're rolling a configuration change now. We're investigating root cause and will provide an update within 48 hours. A full incident summary and RCA will be posted within 7 business days.
```

Tim (Comms): Suggest shortening and avoid technical jargon for status page. Proposed wording:
"Between 09:12–09:45 UTC we experienced increased latency impacting some API requests. Customers may have seen timeouts or slower responses. We applied a fix and are monitoring. We will publish a full incident summary and RCA within 7 business days. Enterprise customers with questions can contact support@redwood.ai."
:thumbsup:

Shreya (PM): +1 on Tim's wording. For customers asking for RCA access: our policy is to share customer-facing summary publicly, and provide redacted RCAs to affected customers on request. Do we need security sign-off for redaction?

Mike (SRE): Yes — redaction signoff from Security. I'll mark the RCA draft as "for internal review" until redaction notes are applied. Add step in tracker: Security review required.

Elaine (CS): I'll handle the outreach to affected customers once Tim finalizes copy. I'll add a note in INC-4321 with affected customer list.

Tim (Comms): Quick checklist for public comms:
- short statuspage copy (Tim)
- link to incident summary (public) when ready (Elaine)
- private redacted RCA for affected customers (Security + Mike)
- SLA impact note for enterprise (Sales + Elaine)

Mike (SRE): On recurring pattern — I'll add metric dashboards and alert thresholds to prevent silent build-up. ETA: 1 week.

Shreya (PM): Scheduling retro: Friday 15:00 PST. Invite infra, infra-test, product, SRE, CS, Comms.

Elaine (CS): Thanks. Owners: Mike (remediation), Shreya (retro & follow-ups), Tim (statuspage copy), Elaine (customer outreach). Dates in tracker. I'll post final customer-facing copy here when ready. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Updated INC-4321: owners assigned (Mike, Shreya, Tim, Elaine), due dates set.
